Lady Julia Albu’s African Adventure

By: Diana Lucas | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
She 80 her cars 20 years old and she's about to embark on a 100% African Adventure

Summary:
On the 13th June when Lady Julia Albu turns 80, she will get into her car – not a Rolls or Range Rover but an indescribable tiny 1997, Toyota Conquest – and drive up Africa, her destination Alexandra, Egypt from where she will sail across the ocean to England via Greece.

She will be 80, her car is 20, together they make 100 years and this adventure is just up Julia’s street, she makes brave millennials look terrifyingly tame.

It all started last year, she was listening to Jon Maytham on Cape Talk and became incensed when he started talking about the amount, Zuma (or us the tax payer) had spent on his wife’s cars’, R 11 million. Julia phoned Cape Talk and before she knew it she was telling Jon about how she will be going up Africa in her old jalopy.



Further information:
June 13th -Julia will set off from Cape Town pass through Johannesburg – where her cars seats will be upholstered in bright pink roses, gift from a friend of course; onto Gaborone, Botswana into Zambia – staying at Africa House - where she will take a short detour to the Victoria Falls, on to Mozambique, Tanzania, Kenya spend time at Daphne Sheldrick’s Elephant Orphanage …Addis Abba and Ethiopia from where she will in a circular route visit some of the oldest churches in the world onto Sudan…Cairo and finally Alexandra Egypt.

Until the age of 18 Julia was dyslexic and could literally not read a book so a major theme on this journey will be to inspire others on the adventure of reading, the importance of literacy, and will raise money for a literacy based charity.

Apart from a few stops with friends Julia will be camping, last week she bought a tent and learnt how to put it up …. she has 2 camping beds ( because some family members might meet up with her and drive a leg with her…) and a type of camping port-a- loo with a spade. Wherever Julia goes she makes friends sometimes incredibly smart, sometimes they ‘re off the street but they are always interesting and interested in her eccentric style of life and this trip will be no different she wants to meet, greet and eat with the people she encounters on her way, if they offer her a bed, or a bath so much the better.

I propose two ways of covering Julia’s journey, one we interview her at her home, Jakkalsfontein on the West Coast before she leaves on her 8 month adventure ( an hr out of CT). She has her route on maps covering a wall of her house, it’s taken over her life. She’s been in tweeting, facebooking and e mailing other African adventurers, any advice or tips. We can have her putting up her tent on the beach outside her house, …packing for her journey…she will be taking her pearls she might be camping but there’s no need to look bad. Show her car, interview her while driving around and then use generic shots to show the route and what she wants to do. Julia is over the top and can hold an interview…. she is an excellent example of geriatrics growing old but not getting old.

Then I think we should meet up with her again at the Elephant Sanctuary, or Africa House, or at the end of her trip where we will have more visuals to show and we can inspire others with her adventures on this remarkable trip. When asked why she’s doing this she says “Because I can” She might be turning 80 but feels 30, it’s about smelling the roses.

Diana Lucas

Press Release:


Lady Julia Albu
Driving from Cape Town to Egypt, Lady Julia Albu celebrates 80 years of age by embarking on the ultimate African adventure. In her trusted carriage – a 1997 Toyota
Conquest – she will drive through the continent before setting sail across the ocean to England. Carte Blanche meets this remarkable adventurer

Script:


Link
Over the years of Carte Blanche we have met some incredibly brave and intrepid explorers who have circumnavigated the continent on a bicycle….

Who have tackled the toughest terrain to embrace diverse cultures

And who have stared death in the face scaling Africa’s highest peak

V/O 14 sec
Now meet 79 year old Julia Albu who on her 80th birthday will get in her car and drive from her home in Jakkals fontein … an hour west of Cape Town, up North through Africa until Egypt.

Julia: Welcome Welcome I am so happy to see you.

V/O 5 sec
And this is Tracy, her car a 1997 Toyota Conquest.

Julia: You know I believe a car has a soul and she has been with me for 20 years and 20 years later she has had a face lift

V/O 11 sec
From Johannesburg Julia plans to head up through Zambia….. around Lake Malawi through Tanzania, Kenya, Ethiopia, Sudan and finally Egypt.
Julia: In Egypt I ship her over to Greece and then we are going through Europe though Croatia through Venice, Milan Zurich and then London
Derek: And are you going to take on London
Julia I’m going to take on London …London will never have seen anything like it.

Link
So where did Julia’s amazing Africa adventure begin was it a dream was it a vision No it was actually a radio station and one phone call in May last year.

John: Julia in Jakkalsfontein Hello to you.
Julia: Hello John
Julia It started with John Maytham and he was talking about cars
…and what people spend on cars well I was shattered and I rang him up in an absolute fury:
Julia: I just felt I had to ring you because I plan to drive my little car which next year will be 20 years and I will be 80 and I plan to drive to London.
John LAUGHS

Julia: What made me say that to this day I will never know I put the phone down and I said who was that mad woman?
And it was you.
It was me.

V/O 17 sec
Julia has always dreamt of discovering Africa…last year her partner of 33 years died and she decided this was the time. Well wishers have appeared out of the woodwork donating water filters, tyres, a roof rack. This is a dream that refused to die.

Up Sound Julia

Carel: Everybody said you are mad Julia and I said go for it because if you are at the age of 80 and still have that spirit you will be able to achieve it.

V/O 13 sec
Carel der Beer has colon cancer and he knows the importance of living life to the full …Carl has donated petrol for the entire trip all 17 and a half thousand kilometres of it.

Carel: I think one of the things of the cancer was today might be the last day so when she told me about this dream I said let’s make it real.
V/O 6 sec
Julia’s 4 children and son in law are joining her on different legs of the drive.

Julia: Well initially they backed it frantically they thought it was wonderful and then When they knew I was serious they said you are mad you can’t do it and I said No I am going t do it and now of course they are all coming because it is wonderful it is a bonding time
LINK
Travelling all the way to Egypt in a 20 year, old car that’s done over 300 000 kms you want to know it’s in tip top condition.

V/O 10 sec
Thanks to Julia’s son in law Joost van der Ploeg and his team, Tracy has had a complete overhaul, It was mechanic Withrow Baron…who signed it off.

Withrow : I think this car is better than the knew ones and it will do the trip
You don’t think she is a little bit crazy,
No she can do it.
Tracy or Julia
Both of them

Derek: Now you have had to give Julia a few lessons about maintaining or repairing a car?
Joost: We have given a lot of lessons but I don’t think she has learned them.
Derek: So what have you told her?
Joost Essentially the basics, just trying to keep her in tune with of what’s happening

Derek: Can we look under the bonnet
Julia :Clean a beautiful engine Everything in working order…
…I found the oil this is the most important thing you have got to watch the oil you have to watch your water because she can overheat I’m carrying water with me I have spare oil What is good about this car if you break down anywhere there is always a tea room which will have a spare part,
Derek: And she has only done 330 000
Julia: 337 000…just run in….shes going to go like a bird she does go like a bird
Derek: She cleans up very nicely
*Beautifully I mean for me I never thought I would look at the inside of an engine with such a loving look.

V/O
While Tracy’s engine is clearly important it’s not the only priority for this trip.

Julia:…now look at this fabric this fabric is
Derek: This is Unique,
Julia: Actually she is my drawing room all I need is a drinks tray

V/O
Even the spare wheel cover is an exquisite match.
Derek: We have interviewed a few explorers but none of them have had matching covers I think that’s where they have gone wrong.
Julia: If you are going to be in a car for the length of time that I am going to be in the car why be surrounded by just drab awful upholstery. ////

V/O 14 and a half sec
But Julia’s adventure is also about raising awareness and money for the charity in her life Shine literacy … so people can follow her trip all the way up donating to Shine for every kilometre she drives.

Link
Well this is Julia’s home for the next 6 months when she is not staying with friends all the basic necessities like the toilet chair and a few luxuries like 2 varieties of coffee.
Julia :It seem you are expecting some chilly weather up there
You’ve got to be prepared I’m going up North and I know it turns into winter. So I am taking my dressing gown and slippers and beany

Derek: I can see you are There must be times are you doing the right thing
From 2 o clock in the morning on you wake up in the morning and you think what am I doing and you snuggle in to your bed and say what am I doing what am I leaving I don’t know where I am going

V/O
Early on the 13th June, Julia’s 80th Birthday she sets off from Jakkalsfontein, …we meet again in Johannesburg. With her until Victoria Falls is Zambi her daughter.

Derek: Has your Mom been relaxed through out this…
Zambi No no she has been impossible
Derek Impossible
Zambi: Yes Absolutely impossible///and a lot of the time has been calming her down just trying to get her to chill.

Derek: How was Tracy performing on the warm up here to JHB?
Julia: She purred the whole way up she was absolutely superb what is another 17 000 kms…nothing

V/O 10 sec
And a cavalcade of Harley Davidson riders ( from the Pretoria branch) escort Julia for 100 kms sending her off Northwards with a roar……
it’s a reality now but you know what for me it’s a meeting greeting and eating experience. I eant to meet the people I want to eat their food I want to share what I have got with them. The world is out there you have got to see it all
